description: This file defines the 'Action' class within the OpenCart framework, providing functionality to store, execute, and manage actions (such as controller calls) within the engine. It handles constructing action objects from routes, executing controllers via a registry, and managing method calls securely.

classes.name: Action
classes.description: Represents a framework action that can be executed; stores route, controller, and method information, and provides execution logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the action with a route string, sanitizing and parsing it to determine controller and method.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the route string identifying the action.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the stored action by retrieving and calling the appropriate controller method via the registry.
